notes: NOT grouped, unlike erp-voorcalculatie and erp-abonnementen: one row is one vast actief, and FiFixedAssets has no nested regel object at all (57 fields, zero sub-objects). The ordinary one-row-one-record path applies.

THE `(F)` SUFFIX IS THE WHOLE READING OF THIS TEMPLATE: it means fiscaal, and AFAS carries two parallel sets of afschrijvingsvelden on this connector — a fiscal set (FiYn, ViDf, FiAm, LiYe, SaVa, DaSd, FyLi, FpLi, FiDi) and a commercial one with different codes for the same concepts (CoYn, ViDc, FiCa, LiCo, SaCo, DaCo, CyLi, CpLi, CoCu). Every `(F)` column above is mapped to the FISCAL field. Getting this wrong is the silent-bad-data failure on this connector: 'Restwaarde (F)' into SaCo instead of SaVa lands a real number in the commercial ledger and nothing complains. The template has no commercial columns, so the commercial set is left entirely unmapped.

AutoNum (Vast actief autonummeren) is mandatory and fixed `true`: the template has no Activacode column, so AFAS assigns the number itself. Same precedent as KnPerson/KnOrganisation's AutoNum on the medewerkers and relatie mappings. `SeNo` (Activacode) is therefore deliberately unmapped — filling both would be a contradiction.

NOT MAPPED — `Administratie` (kolom 6 of the template, 'Administratienummer in AFAS'). FiFixedAssets has NO administratie field: all 57 fields were checked against live metainfo and there is no UnId/UnFi on this connector, unlike FiEntries (erp-openstaandposten) which carries UnId at kop level. So the administratie is not part of this body — it is presumably decided by the environment the call is made against, or implied by the activagroep, which the template's own note supports ('Activagroepcode (verschilt per administratie)'). Worth confirming before a multi-administratie conversion: if a customer's activagroepcodes repeat across administraties, this mapping cannot tell them apart and the column has nowhere to go.

Values that need NO translation: `Afschrijvingsmethode (F)` — the template's Hulptabel offers L, M, D, P, B, W and all six are ids in ViDf's own allowed-value list (which also holds R and A, unused by the sjabloon), with matching descriptions (L = Bedrag lineaire afschrijving, M = Degressieve methode, D = Direct afschrijven, P = Percentage lineaire afschrijving, B = Percentage van de boekwaarde, W = Willekeurig afschrijven). Unlike erp-voorcalculatie's VaIt, this column can go straight through.

`Fiscale afschrijving (F)` is a J/N column feeding a boolean field. `afasValue()` reads 'J' as true and 'N' as false (its yes-list is true/ja/j/1/waar), so no transform is needed — but note it converts on the field's declared type, so this only holds because FiYn really is a boolean in the schema.

The rule set and the template agree here, unlike erp-abonnementen: all 15 rule columns exist in the sjabloon under exactly those names, and the template's one extra column is `Administratie`, which the rules do not check and this mapping cannot place (above). Nothing to reconcile.

Left out entirely: the commercial afschrijving set (see above), the second/third/fourth/fifth verbijzonderingen (ANO3-ANO5 — the template has only two), and the ~30 remaining optional fields (medewerker, leverancier, locatie, aantal stuks, referentienummer, gekoppeld actief, additionele kosten, type actief ViAk, bodemwaarde, herinvesteringsreserve, vervroegde afschrijving, serienummer/puk/garantie, memo, project/projectfase, item, bewakingscode, bijlage). No column feeds any of them.
No mandatory field is left unmapped: AutoNum (fixed), Ds, FgSn and DaPu are the four AFAS marks mandatory, and all four are filled.

verifiedAgainst.description: Live GET /api/afas/updateconnectors/modules/FiFixedAssets — root/name 'FiFixedAssets' (same as the connector id), 57 fields and NO nested objects. Mandatory: AutoNum, Ds, FgSn, DaPu. ViDf's allowed values read from the same call and matched against the template's Hulptabel.
